description: This file defines the 'Waiter' class used for managing event waiting, timeouts, and error handling within the Playwright core testing framework. It includes methods for waiting on events, rejecting on timeouts or specific events, logging, and error message rewriting.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: A class for managing event waiting, error handling, and logging within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: createForEvent
methods.description: Static method to create a Waiter instance for a specific event.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on an EventEmitter, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: rejectOnEvent
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a specific event occurs, with an error.

methods.name: rejectOnTimeout
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a timeout occurs, with a TimeoutError.

methods.name: rejectImmediately
methods.description: Immediately rejects the wait with a provided error.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all resources and event listeners.

methods.name: waitForPromise
methods.description: Waits for a promise to resolve or reject, handling immediate errors and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message and sends it through the channel.

methods.name: _rejectOn
methods.description: Internal method to add a rejection promise to the failure list.
